items.t: Yinhawangka People and Rio Tinto celebrate landmark modernised agreement
items.sum: PERTH, Australia, November 26, 2026--The Yinhawangka People, Yinhawangka Aboriginal Corporation (YAC) and Rio Tinto have signed a fully modernised Participation Agreement, marking a landmark achievement that delivers significantly improved benefits for current and future generations of Yinhawangka People.

items.t: Should Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) Investors Worry About This Discrimination Lawsuit?

The claim alleges the miner targeted staff with family care responsibilities and replaced roles with younger contractors. items.t: Rio Tinto to commit C$10M over five years to food security in Canada
items.sum: MONTREAL, November 24, 2026--Rio Tinto will commit C$10 million over five years to food security through the Rio Tinto Canada Fund. The Beyond Food initiative will support community organisations and Indigenous partners in meeting immediate needs and strengthening local capacity over the medium and long term.

items.t: UK miners rise as copper rebounds from 11-month low
items.sum: Investing.com -- British mining stocks rallied on Thursday, with Fresnillo, Endeavour Mining, Glencore, Anglo American and Rio Tinto rising between 2.9% and 4.8% as copper rebounded from an 11-month low.

items.t: AI fears trigger plunge in copper prices
items.sum: Plummeting market confidence in the AI investment boom has swept through copper prices and mining stocks, wiping out a year of gains.
